preserved_analysis.next_action: Obtain the original prompts, confirmation sequence, action previews, execution receipts, file-recovery outcome, and public or private vendor findings where available. Determine whether the incidents share a structural pattern of material side-effect scope expansion, destructive execution without consequence-aware confirmation, bulk-action confirmation failure, recipient-resolution error, GUI-selection error, or action-state misrepresentation. Then either extend FM-0001 and its repair coverage or create a distinct failure mode and patch pathway.

possible_taxonomy_mapping.candidate_failure_description: An agent executes or prepares an externally consequential action whose destructive, distributive, recipient, volume, persistence, or reversibility scope materially exceeds what the user specifically authorised or reasonably understood, without a renewed preview-and-confirm boundary.
possible_taxonomy_mapping.classification_limit: This mapping is provisional. The available evidence does not yet establish whether the underlying incidents involved scope expansion, confirmation bypass, erroneous GUI selection, recipient-resolution error, destructive-command error, misrepresented completion state, or another execution pathway.

preserved_analysis.summary: Three user-supplied X links are preserved as early-warning evidence concerning two reported high-impact side-effect incidents during ChatGPT computer-use workflows. A follow-up post by Matt Shumer, supplied verbatim by the CAM maintainer, states that GPT-5.6-Sol at the highest reasoning level accidentally deleted almost all files on his Mac and that the OpenAI team was investigating. A separate report was described as involving email transmission to a large recipient group. The exact user instructions, confirmation states, action sequence, deletion reversibility, recipient scope, execution receipts, and root-cause allocation remain unverified.

preserved_analysis.why_it_matters_to_CAM: Computer-use systems can convert ambiguous language, broad task goals, or local planning errors into external side effects. Deletion and broad-recipient communication require heightened execution-boundary discipline because consequences may be irreversible, reputationally damaging, privacy-invasive, or difficult to reconstruct. These reports may indicate a failure distinct from premature tool invocation: the user may have authorised computer use generally while the agent materially expanded the destructive, distributive, recipient, volume, or persistence scope of the authorised task without a fresh preview-and-confirm boundary.
